alternative_or_falsification_rule: Replace the full-bundle-versus-Lite-plus-Melon basket match with the embedded-music-component-versus-Melon match used in BSW03.
what_it_checks: Checks whether the same-country bundle advantage survives when the comparator is the calibrated music component rather than the full YouTube bundle product.
implication_for_extension_strength: Supports the same-country undercut story, but only as a product-match robustness check rather than a license to upgrade wording because the alternative match uses a calibrated component.

what_it_checks: Checks whether the same-country paid-entry shock depends on choosing Melon rather than another observed Korean-market audio comparator.
implication_for_extension_strength: Supports the paid-entry mechanism as comparator-robust across two Korean-market controls, but remains a short-window proxy rather than a full DID estimate.

what_it_checks: Checks whether the observed price-entry shock is specific to the Premium Lite remedy rather than generic post-period drift inside the YouTube ecosystem.
implication_for_extension_strength: Strengthens the interpretation that the observed -3490 price-entry shift is remedy-specific, but only under the same short-window stable-control assumption already used in the DID-style proxy.

alternative_or_falsification_rule: Require any extension headline to pass an export-only check: all rows in the foreign-metric panel are coded export_facing_primary, and the v2 layer remains weak_support.
what_it_checks: Checks that export-facing scoreboard dependence is not reimported as proof of Korean average-industry discrimination in the strengthened extension.
implication_for_extension_strength: This is a guardrail rather than supportive robustness: it blocks stronger industry-wide wording and keeps foreign-metric evidence in an adjunct export-facing role.

alternative_or_falsification_rule: Downweight weak-data layers L4 and L5 by one-half while keeping L1-L3 at unit weight: (L1+L2+L3+0.5*L4+0.5*L5)/4.
what_it_checks: Checks whether the overall extension story depends mechanically on weak-data layers such as export metrics and tax observability.
implication_for_extension_strength: The score rises modestly when weak-data layers are downweighted, but this does not justify stronger wording because the change comes from an ad hoc weighting sensitivity rather than new identification.
